## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3006. The PVC `data-ledger-db-0` is stuck in Terminating state because Kubernetes' Storage Object in Use Protection feature is preventing deletion—the `ledger-db-0` Pod is still Running and actively using the PVC. The fix is to delete the ledger-db-0 Pod, which will automatically remove the `kubernetes.io/pvc-protection` finalizer and allow the PVC deletion to complete.
